verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents deploying or running Elastic Observability itself (Elasticsearch/Kibana/APM) on user-managed infrastructure. The available evidence is only adjacent: running Elastic Agent in a container concerns the data collector, not the core platform. General 'open by design' and 'open source' platform claims do not document a self-hosted deployment of the observability product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
